verdicts.summary: The two hazards this note names are a bare `status: null` settling a running compaction as stopped, and a stale completed item reused by a later boundary. Findings 0 and 1 already state them. I found no further break in the settle paths.
Web and mobile client logic holds up against the cases I tried. Terminal compaction statuses stop the shimmer and the running check. A stale running item cannot keep `isCompacting` true across runs.
verdicts.scenario: Case 1: a running compaction item left over from a crashed or older run keeps `isCompacting` true in a new run. The run-id match excludes it. Case 2: a failed or interrupted item in the active run keeps the web row shimmering. The row is active only when the entry is `inProgress`. Failed maps to `failed`, and interrupted and cancelled map to `stopped`, so the row stops. Case 3: steering during compaction. Web composer `canSteer` and mobile `canSteerActiveTurn` are both `!isCompacting`, so it is blocked on both.
